source_caption_text:
Speed really had one song in mind 😭

IShowSpeed really made “N****s in Paris” the first song he played on the new iPhone Duo, bringing his usual chaotic energy to Apple’s big launch event. After getting his hands on the new phone, Speed wasted no time putting the speakers to the test.

With the iconic Jay-Z and Kanye West track blasting from the phone, the moment instantly stood out from the rest of the event. While Apple was focused on showing off its latest technology, Speed had a completely different way of testing the new device.

The clip quickly became a hilarious moment from the launch, perfectly capturing Speed’s personality. Somehow, he managed to turn a major Apple event into another classic IShowSpeed moment.

Via @ishowspeed

#ishowspeed #kanyewest #rap
